rationale: Continuation of Russian retaliatory strikes on Kyiv bridges after Crimean Bridge attack; pattern already established in memory, no qualitative new escalation this cycle.

top_events.title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
top_events.label: Russia strikes three Kyiv bridges killing five
top_events.summary: Russian retaliatory strikes hit three Kyiv bridges, killing five, following Ukraine's successful Crimean Bridge attack. Continues established pattern of infrastructure targeting.

top_events.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
top_events.label: Europe announces united Ukraine negotiating position
top_events.summary: European allies announce united negotiating position at Berlin summit for potential Russia talks. Rhetoric without concrete action; no immediate change to war situation.

top_events.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
top_events.label: Trump Putin Xi release peace declaration
top_events.summary: First trilateral meeting of three leaders produces peace declaration. Rhetoric without concrete terms; no immediate impact on Ukraine war situation.

most_significant_event.label: Russian double-tap strike kills 72 rescuers
most_significant_event.summary: Russia deliberately targets rescue workers with follow-up strikes in southern Ukraine, killing 72 and hampering body recovery. Intensified attacks on civilian responders.
